about_the_game:
About the Game

Just Shoot is a fast-paced action roguelite featuring massive enemy hordes, insane builds, and a secret card combo system that can completely transform your run.

Control your character in top-down combat, dodge hundreds of enemies, discover devastating weapons, and create powerful combinations that can completely break the game.

But be careful: the longer you survive, the more chaotic everything becomes.

Frenetic Combat and Full Control

In Just Shoot, you aim and shoot manually while freely moving across the map.

Survival requires quick reflexes, smart positioning, and strategy as waves of enemies flood the screen.

Every second counts.

Every mistake can be fatal.

Unique Weapons

During each run you can find random weapons (as long as they are unlocked), each with its own behavior and combat style.

The game currently features 13 different weapons, with more planned for future updates.

Some weapons are fast.
Some are devastating.
Some are simply pure chaos.

Card System and Builds

During a run you will find special cards that completely modify your build.

They can increase damage, speed, projectile count, visual effects, and much more.

But the real secret lies in the combinations.

Some cards activate special combos when combined correctly.

These combos can unlock devastating effects.

And the best part:
there is no guide.

Some card combinations can trigger hidden powers, upgraded weapons, or unexpected effects.

Discover them on your own.

Playable Characters

The game currently features 5 playable characters, each with different stats.

Some are faster.
Others are tougher.
Some deal significantly more damage.

Roguelite Progression

When you die, you lose the items collected during that run — but your overall progress remains.

You can use your progress to:

• Unlock new characters
• Unlock new weapons
• Open new stages

Just Shoot hides secrets throughout the game.

Hidden challenges.
Secret achievements.
Unexpected combinations.

Some builds can become ridiculously powerful if you discover the right combination.
